capture.command:
pscap (scratch Go tool performing internal/portscan Probe's socket IO: one 512-byte banner read with 1.5 s timeout; on HTTP ports write 'HEAD / HTTP/1.0
Host: <host>

' first; on TLS ports handshake with InsecureSkipVerify, save the peer chain as DER, then send the HEAD); run from the lab manager container 192.168.128.4 on the fxlab-b bridge: pscap -host <container> -port <port> -mode <banner|http|tls> -name <port>-<service>

files.name: 5432-postgresql.banner
files.description: raw bytes the service sent (what readBanner reads before printable())

files.name: 5432-postgresql.json
files.description: capture record: host, port, mode, byte count, TLS outcome, chain files

notes: PostgreSQL waits for a startup message: the recorded banner is empty and the TLS retry (no SSLRequest) failed, so classification falls back on the port.
